data.gender_notes: Nayyara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who embarks on a spiritual journey during the night. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the night is a time for worship and seeking closeness to Allah. Nayyara is a name filled with spiritual significance and encourages a deep connection with the divine. The name Nayyara carries the meaning “Night traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nayyara usually hope their child will grow to embody night traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
